summary: 500 Terry A. Francois Boulevard (Mission Bay Block 26A) is a 6-story office building in Mission Bay, developed as ML Mission Bay LLC with Swinerton Builders as general contractor per the project's precast contractor's own page, which -- together with DataSF Assessor records -- dates its completion to 2008.

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (blklot 8721010, 500 Terry A. Francois Blvd): year_property_built 2008

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2008 completion is not sourced, only the year.

The building's architect and its later Cisco/Meraki tenant history are documented elsewhere (this project's own geometry file cites the SF Chronicle for the Meraki lease) but were not independently re-verified in this minimal-dossier pass, so are left out here rather than repeated unsourced.
